steps.overzicht.title: Overview and report
report.disclaimer: This report does not constitute legal or financial advice. It helps you identify points of attention before you decide whether to sign the account and justification report.
report.kerncijfers.title: Key figures
report.amountReconciliationNote: These checks only show whether the figures in the document are internally consistent — they do not guarantee the figures match reality. Always compare the start and end balances with your own bank statements or online banking.
report.check.nietGecontroleerd: Not checked — fill in the net worth totals stated in the document under Income/Expenses to activate this check.
report.betrokkeneSignalen.title: Signals from the person under administration
report.severityGroup.fout.title: Errors
report.severityGroup.fout.uitleg: Objective arithmetic errors — the figures in the document do not add up.
report.severityGroup.rodeVlag.title: Red flags
report.severityGroup.rodeVlag.uitleg: Serious points that call for a written explanation.
report.severityGroup.aandachtspunt.title: Points of attention
report.summary.title: Summary
report.summary.text: This check found {foutCount} error(s), {rodeVlagCount} red flag(s) and {aandachtspuntCount} point(s) of attention. This report supports your own decision — it does not replace it.
report.summary.advies: For serious findings, consider asking your administrator for a written explanation, and if necessary, object in good time with the supervising subdistrict court judge, or contact the Legal Aid Board (Juridisch Loket) for independent advice.
report.summary.rechtbankWaarschuwing: Keep in mind: the administrator normally reports to the court themselves whether you signed and whether you agree. If in doubt, contact the court that issued the measure directly.
rules.afwijkingTotalen.title: Discrepancy between account movements and income/expenses
rules.afwijkingTotalen.explanation: The increase or decrease in the balances of the bank, savings and living-allowance accounts differs by {bedrag} from the difference between total income and total expenses. This should be exactly €0.00.
rules.afwijkingTotalen.suggestion: Ask your administrator for a written explanation of this difference of {bedrag}.
rules.controleVermogensopstelling.title: The stated total assets do not match the detailed overview
rules.controleVermogensopstelling.explan: The document itself states a total net worth at the start and end of the period. Added up from the separate overviews of assets and debts, this comes out {bedrag} differently.
rules.controleVermogensopstelling.sugges: Ask your administrator how this difference of {bedrag} came about.
rules.afwijkingGerapporteerdInkomen.titl: The stated Total income does not match the sum of the individual entries
rules.afwijkingGerapporteerdInkomen.expl: The document itself states a Total income (A). That amount differs by {bedrag} from the sum of the individual income entries you entered.
rules.afwijkingGerapporteerdInkomen.sugg: Re-check the income entries in the document itself, or ask your administrator for an explanation.
rules.afwijkingGerapporteerdUitgaven.tit: The stated Total expenses does not match the sum of the individual entries
rules.afwijkingGerapporteerdUitgaven.exp: The document itself states a Total expenses (B). That amount differs by {bedrag} from the sum of the individual expense entries you entered.
rules.afwijkingGerapporteerdUitgaven.sug: Re-check the expense entries in the document itself, or ask your administrator for an explanation.
rules.beloningBovenTarief.title: Administrator/guardian fee is above the statutory guideline rate
rules.beloningBovenTarief.explanation: A fee of {bedrag} was entered for the administrator or guardian. The statutory guideline rate for this situation is {tarief} per year. VAT and one-off fees (such as an intake fee) may legitimately come on top of this — so this is not proof that anything is wrong.
rules.beloningBovenTarief.suggestion: Ask your administrator for a breakdown of this amount, explaining which part is VAT or a one-off fee.
rules.beloningMentorBovenTarief.title: Mentor fee is above the statutory guideline rate
rules.beloningMentorBovenTarief.explanat: A fee of {bedrag} was entered for the mentor. The statutory guideline rate for this situation is {tarief} per year. VAT and one-off fees may legitimately come on top of this — so this is not proof that anything is wrong.
rules.beloningMentorBovenTarief.suggesti: Ask your mentor for a breakdown of this amount.
rules.schuldenZonderSchuldeisers.title: Debts reported, but no creditors listed
rules.schuldenZonderSchuldeisers.explana: The document indicates there are debts, but no creditor with an amount has been filled in.
rules.schuldenZonderSchuldeisers.suggest: Ask your administrator for a complete overview of the creditors and the amounts.
rules.pgbZonderGegevens.title: Personal budget (PGB) reported, but details are missing
rules.pgbZonderGegevens.explanation: The document indicates there is a personal budget (PGB), but the account number or the amount received is missing.
rules.pgbZonderGegevens.suggestion: Ask your administrator to fill in the missing PGB details.
rules.nalatenschapZonderGegevens.title: Undivided inheritance reported, but details are missing
rules.nalatenschapZonderGegevens.explana: The document indicates there is an undivided inheritance, but essential details (such as the deceased's name or how it was accepted) are missing.
rules.nalatenschapZonderGegevens.suggest: Ask your administrator to fill in these details.
rules.gekoppeldReiskosten.title: Travel cost allowance received, but not passed on
rules.gekoppeldReiskosten.explanation: {bedrag} was received as a travel cost allowance, but €0.00 in travel costs is recorded as an expense for you.
rules.gekoppeldReiskosten.suggestion: Check whether this amount was actually spent on your travel costs, and if not, what it was used for instead.
rules.gekoppeldKinderopvang.title: Childcare benefit received, but no childcare costs paid
rules.gekoppeldKinderopvang.explanation: {bedrag} was received as a childcare benefit, but €0.00 in childcare costs is recorded as an expense.
rules.gekoppeldKinderopvang.suggestion: Check what this benefit was used for.
rules.onverwachtNulKleding.title: Clothing and footwear: €0.00 for the whole period
rules.onverwachtNulKleding.explanation: €0.00 is recorded for clothing and footwear for the entire period. That is unusual for a full year.
rules.onverwachtNulKleding.suggestion: Ask why nothing was spent on this, or which other category these costs may be included under.
rules.boetesAanwezig.title: Fines recorded
rules.boetesAanwezig.explanation: {bedrag} in fines is recorded as an expense.
rules.boetesAanwezig.suggestion: Ask what these fine(s) were for, and whether they could have been avoided.
rules.giftenBovenDrempel.title: Gifts and donations above the threshold
rules.giftenBovenDrempel.explanation: {bedrag} in gifts and donations is recorded. This type of expense usually requires written authorisation from the subdistrict court judge.
rules.giftenBovenDrempel.suggestion: Ask your administrator for a copy of the authorisation for this gift or donation.
rules.overigeUitgavenGrootAandeel.title: "Other expenses" make up a large share of total expenses
rules.overigeUitgavenGrootAandeel.explan: The "other expenses" entry amounts to {bedrag}, or {percentage}% of total expenses. A large "other" entry without a breakdown makes it hard to assess what the money was spent on.
rules.overigeUitgavenGrootAandeel.sugges: Ask your administrator for a breakdown of this entry.
rules.betrokkeneKanNietBeoordelen.title: The administrator states you were not able to understand or assess the report
rules.betrokkeneKanNietBeoordelen.explan: The document states that you would not be able to understand and assess the account and justification report.
rules.betrokkeneKanNietBeoordelen.sugges: If you disagree, put this in writing to both your administrator and the court that issued the measure.
rules.nietOndertekendNietGereageerd.titl: Stated: you would not have responded to an invitation to discuss the report
rules.nietOndertekendNietGereageerd.expl: The document states that you did not respond to an invitation to discuss the account and justification report.
rules.nietOndertekendNietGereageerd.sugg: Does this not match what you remember? Contact the court that issued the measure directly — the administrator is the one who reports this to the court, so when in doubt, checking with the court itself is the most reliable option.
rules.nietOndertekendAfgewezen.title: Stated: you would have declined an invitation to discuss the report
rules.nietOndertekendAfgewezen.explanati: The document states that you declined an invitation to discuss the account and justification report.
rules.nietOndertekendAfgewezen.suggestio: Does this not match what you remember? Contact the court that issued the measure directly.
rules.nietOndertekendNietInStaat.title: Stated: you would not be (deemed) able to respond
rules.nietOndertekendNietInStaat.explana: The document states that you would not be (deemed) able to respond to an invitation to discuss the report.
rules.nietOndertekendNietInStaat.suggest: If you disagree, put this in writing to both your administrator and the court that issued the measure.
rules.nietOndertekendNietAkkoord.title: You do not agree with the content
rules.nietOndertekendNietAkkoord.explana: The document states that you do not agree with the content of the account and justification report.
rules.nietOndertekendNietAkkoord.suggest: Make sure your objections are also known to the court in writing, not just to the administrator — the administrator is normally the one who reports this to the court.
rules.betrokkeneNietEensMetAntwoorden.ti: You disagree with the administrator's answers
rules.betrokkeneNietEensMetAntwoorden.ex: You indicated that you disagree with the answers the administrator filled in about you.
rules.betrokkeneNietEensMetAntwoorden.su: Make sure this disagreement is also known to the court in writing.
rules.bijlageRekeningafschriftenOntbreek: Each bank, savings or living-allowance account should come with a statement or annual overview showing the opening and closing balance. You indicated this is not (fully) included.
Ask your administrator for the missing statements, or request them directly from your bank.
rules.bijlagePgbBeschikkingOntbreekt.exp: A personal budget should come with its (determination) decision letter. You indicated this is not included.
rules.bijlagePgbBeschikkingOntbreekt.sug: Ask your administrator to send this decision letter after all.
rules.bijlageMachtigingenOntbreekt.title: Authorisation for certain expenses is missing
rules.bijlageMachtigingenOntbreekt.expla: Gifts, donations or other expenses that require authorisation from the subdistrict court judge should come with that authorisation. You indicated this is not included.
rules.bijlageMachtigingenOntbreekt.sugge: Ask your administrator for a copy of the authorisation.
rules.bijlageWozHypotheekOntbreekt.title: Property valuation (WOZ) decision or mortgage overview is missing
rules.bijlageWozHypotheekOntbreekt.expla: Real estate should come with the property valuation (WOZ) decision and an overview from the mortgage lender. You indicated this is not included.
rules.bijlageWozHypotheekOntbreekt.sugge: Ask your administrator to send these documents after all.
rules.bijlageNalatenschapDocumentenOntbr: An undivided inheritance should come with supporting documents (such as the will or the estate description). You indicated these are not included.
Ask your administrator to send these documents after all.
